description: This Java class 'Command' is a wrapper for AMQP 1.0 messages representing commands in the Eclipse Hono client. It provides methods to create, validate, and extract information from command messages, including handling reply-to addresses, correlation IDs, and payloads.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: A final class representing a command message in the Hono client, providing creation, validation, and property access methods.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a Command instance from an AMQP message, tenant ID, and device ID, validating message properties and adjusting reply-to addresses as needed.

methods.name: getCommandMessage
methods.description: Returns the underlying AMQP message representing this command.

methods.name: isOneWay
methods.description: Determines if the command is one-way (no response expected) based on reply-to ID.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the command contains all required valid information.

methods.name: getInvalidCommandReason
methods.description: Provides the reason why the command is invalid; throws if command is valid.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the command's name (subject); throws if invalid.

methods.name: getTenant
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID; throws if invalid.

methods.name: getDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID; throws if invalid.

methods.name: isTargetedAtGateway
methods.description: Checks if the command is targeted at a gateway based on device IDs.

methods.name: getOriginalDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the original device ID from the message, considering redirection to gateways.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID used for correlating responses.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns the message payload Buffer.

methods.name: getPayloadSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the payload in bytes.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the message payload.

methods.name: getReplyToId
methods.description: Returns the reply-to ID from the message.

methods.name: getReplyToEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the reply-to endpoint name used in the message.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID.

methods.name: getApplicationProperties
methods.description: Returns the application properties map.

methods.name: getDeviceFacingReplyToId
methods.description: Constructs a reply-to ID that starts with the device ID, encoding reply-to options.

methods.name: encodeReplyToOptions
methods.description: Encodes reply-to options as a single digit string based on boolean flags.

methods.name: isReplyToContainedDeviceIdOptionSet
methods.description: Checks if the reply-to contained device ID based on the encoded options string.

methods.name: isReplyToLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if the reply-to was directed at the legacy endpoint based on the encoded options string.
